name: 荷叶边小熊滑雪套装（奶白 × 粉色）
description:
奶白色外套配粉色工装雪裤，甜美又好拍照。尺码 M。

## 设计细节
- 外套前襟两条粉色荷叶边飘带
- 两个口袋上各一只毛绒小熊刺绣
- 帽子上有粉色小熊耳朵，背后 Skibear 字样
- 宽松落肩版型，里面可以穿厚一点
- 粉色工装雪裤，侧边大口袋，裤脚抽绳可以收口
descriptionEn:
A cream jacket with pink cargo snow pants — sweet and made for photos. Size M.

## Design Details
- Two pink ruffle ribbons down the front of the jacket
- Fluffy embroidered bears on both pockets
- Pink bear ears on the hood and Skibear lettering on the back
- Relaxed dropped-shoulder fit with room for warm layers
- Pink cargo snow pants with big side pockets and drawstring cuffs

name: 爱心小熊背带滑雪套装（卡其色）

items.size: 上衣 L · 背带裤 XL

description:
奶黄色立领上衣 + 卡其色背带裤，胸前一只奶白色小熊头，两条裤腿上各有一颗奶白色爱心，软萌又显小。同款还有奶白色背带裤。注意尺码：上衣 L、背带裤 XL。

## 面料与科技
- 3 层复合科技面料，全天候防水，阻雪进入
- 防水指数 15000，透气透湿 10000
- 全压胶，防止渗水
- 内里加绒，表面抗风，舒适保暖
- 胸前小熊采用硅胶烫画工艺

## 尺码（上衣 L · 背带裤 XL）
- 背带裤 XL：裤长 132cm、脚口 58cm、腿围 78cm、腰围 104cm、臀围 134cm
- 版型宽松（Oversize），模特身高 160cm、体重 45kg 穿 M 码
descriptionEn:
A butter-yellow stand-collar top with khaki bib pants: a cream bear face on the bib and a cream heart on each leg. Soft, cute and playful. Also available with cream bib pants. Note the sizes: top L, bib pants XL.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3-layer technical fabric, waterproof in any weather and keeps snow out
- Waterproof rating 15,000; breathability 10,000
- Fully taped seams to stop leaks
- Fleece-lined and windproof for warmth and comfort
- Silicone heat-transfer bear on the bib

## Size (jacket L · bib XL)
- Bib pants XL: length 132 cm, hem 58 cm, thigh 78 cm, waist 104 cm, hips 134 cm
- Oversized fit; the model is 160 cm (5'3") / 45 kg and wears M
